findings.title: Missing HTTP Header: Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: The server response did not include the required 'Content-Security-Policy' header. Restricts sources of executable scripts, stylesheets, and objects.
findings.remediation: Configure the web server or reverse proxy to supply 'Content-Security-Policy' on all HTTP responses.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Header: Strict-Transport-Security
findings.description: The server response did not include the required 'Strict-Transport-Security' header. Enforces HTTPS communication and blocks SSL stripping.
findings.remediation: Configure the web server or reverse proxy to supply 'Strict-Transport-Security' on all HTTP responses.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Header: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: The server response did not include the required 'X-Content-Type-Options' header. Prevents MIME-type sniffing by web browsers.
findings.remediation: Configure the web server or reverse proxy to supply 'X-Content-Type-Options' on all HTTP responses.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Header: X-Frame-Options
findings.description: The server response did not include the required 'X-Frame-Options' header. Protects against clickjacking and UI redress attacks.
findings.remediation: Configure the web server or reverse proxy to supply 'X-Frame-Options' on all HTTP responses.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Header: Referrer-Policy
findings.description: The server response did not include the required 'Referrer-Policy' header. Controls how much referrer information is sent with requests.
findings.remediation: Configure the web server or reverse proxy to supply 'Referrer-Policy' on all HTTP responses.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Header: Permissions-Policy
findings.description: The server response did not include the required 'Permissions-Policy' header. Restricts browser features and device hardware APIs.
findings.remediation: Configure the web server or reverse proxy to supply 'Permissions-Policy' on all HTTP responses.

findings.title: Server Banner Information Disclosure
findings.description: The 'Server' header exposes detailed software versions: 'Apache/2.4.41 (Ubuntu) PHP/7.4.3 '. This aids adversary reconnaissance.
findings.remediation: Disable verbose server tokens in the web server configuration (e.g., ServerTokens Prod in Apache, server_tokens off in Nginx).

findings.title: Insecure CORS Wildcard Allowed
findings.description: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is set to wildcard '*' without origin scoping.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict allowlists for trusted domains rather than using wildcard origin reflections.

findings.title: Session Cookie Missing 'HttpOnly' Flag
findings.description: The session cookie 'session_id=insecure_token_for_alice; Path=/' does not specify 'HttpOnly', allowing client-side scripts (XSS) to read the token.
findings.remediation: Add the 'HttpOnly' flag to all Set-Cookie directives for session identifiers.

findings.title: Session Cookie Missing 'SameSite' Attribute
findings.description: Cookie 'session_id=insecure_token_for_alice; Path=/' lacks 'SameSite=Strict' or 'SameSite=Lax', increasing susceptibility to CSRF attacks.

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA / IDOR) Detected
findings.description: Endpoint '/api/v1/document?id=103' allowed an unauthenticated caller to retrieve confidential administrative records.
findings.remediation: Enforce server-side authorization: scope object retrieval queries strictly to the validated session user identity.

findings.title: SQL Injection & Raw Query Reflection Detected
findings.description: Search endpoint reflected raw SQL string concatenation and executed unescaped query logic.
findings.remediation: Replace string-concatenated SQL queries with strongly-typed prepared statements and parameterized inputs.

passed_checks.title: Cookie Secure Enforced
passed_checks.details: Secure attribute present on authentication cookie.
